Screen translation takes a picture of the app you choose. Anything visible in that app can end up in the picture, including things you didn't mean to capture.
Do NOT use it on anything showing:

If you use AI reading, the picture is sent to that AI service (Claude, Gemini or OpenAI) and handled under their privacy rules, not CIMA Box's. Once it's sent, CIMA Box can't take it back. If you wouldn't post it publicly, don't capture it.

It can read: Arabic, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.

It can't read Hindi, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Hebrew, Ukrainian, Persian or Tagalog, among others. For those, use AI reading. Each language also has to be installed in Windows first (Settings > Time & language > Language).
CIMA Box is free, and it runs on your own accounts: ElevenLabs, and DeepL, Claude, Gemini or OpenAI if you add them. Whatever it uses is charged by those services to your keys.
So please keep an eye on it:
The maker of CIMA Box isn't responsible for charges, used-up credits or tokens, or anything else that comes from using it. You choose the settings, so you use it at your own risk.
